failures.actual: allocation UNAVAILABLE passed; generated_kwh is None
failures.root_cause: Same skip of manual adjustments in wing_graph_rows when mode is AUTO or MANUAL. Missing ledger does not fall back to manual generation.
failures.action: Expect None, not 9000, on the operational wing card. Do not add a manual fallback.

failures.root_cause: 5.0 is the seeded physical wing A value. 8 is 5+3 manual adjustments. Date assertions before this line passed for both UTC clocks.

failures.expected: no relay on/off events during failed reconciliation
failures.actual: 4 off() events from _deenergize_all; 0 on(); FAULT; MAKE refused; verification PENDING or the matching MISMATCH
failures.root_cause: Fail-closed coil-off was added on timeout, mismatch, and multiple-ON. The mock records every off() as a write, including when the coil was already off.
failures.action: Do not remove _deenergize_all, interlock, or pre-MAKE. Change the test to forbid ON and false VERIFIED, and allow fail-closed OFF.

failures.action: Retarget the source check to the current components. Do not weaken backend role checks.

failures.root_cause: In-memory checksum verify passed. Flush then calls os.open(directory, os.O_DIRECTORY). Windows Python has no os.O_DIRECTORY, the exception is caught, and flush returns False.
